title: Better pillagers
body:
![Better pillagers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38064bbd793f40786a90b624bda3e2c4a53ccbe6.png)A simple Minecraft resource pack that gives pillagers a cleaner and more intimidating look while keeping the vanilla style. Crossbow-wielding raiders now have darker clothes, sharper details, and a more polished appearance inspired by classic survival gameplay.

Features
Redesigned pillager texture
Vanilla-friendly style
Works great for survival worlds and adventures
No shaders or mods required
Lightweight and simple
Includes
Updated pillager skin
Improved outfit colors and details
Better overall atmosphere for raids
Optifine or etf with emf Required
